# SonarCloud rules digest

<!-- Generated by scripts/sonar-rules-digest.mjs from docs/quality/sonar-rules.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

The 426 active rules of the `Sonar way comprehensive` TypeScript quality profile
(fetched 2026-11-09) that apply to this codebase, so you can avoid a
finding before the scan reports it. Each links to the rule description, with compliant and
non-compliant examples.

46 more rules in the profile are for frameworks this codebase does not use (tags:
angular, aws, bun, chai, cypress, gcp, jasmine, karma, lodash, mocha, puppeteer, sinon, underscore.js, vue) and are left out.

Refresh the list with `pnpm sonar:rules-digest --refresh` (a private organization needs
`SONAR_TOKEN`), or regenerate this file from the committed list with `pnpm sonar:rules-digest`.
CI fails when this file and `docs/quality/sonar-rules.json` disagree.

## React, JSX and accessibility (65)

- [S1101](https://rules.sonarsource.com/typescript/RSPEC-1101/) (major): Links with identical accessible names should have identical targets

- [S7776](https://rules.sonarsource.com/typescript/RSPEC-7776/) (minor): Arrays used only for existence checks should be Sets
- [S7777](https://rules.sonarsource.com/typescript/RSPEC-7777/) (minor): Set size should be accessed directly instead of converting to array first
- [S7778](https://rules.sonarsource.com/typescript/RSPEC-7778/) (minor): Multiple consecutive calls to methods that accept multiple arguments should be combined
- [S7780](https://rules.sonarsource.com/typescript/RSPEC-7780/) (minor): String literals with escaped backslashes should use `String.raw` template literals
- [S7781](https://rules.sonarsource.com/typescript/RSPEC-7781/) (minor): Strings should use "replaceAll()" instead of "replace()" with global regex
- [S7784](https://rules.sonarsource.com/typescript/RSPEC-7784/) (minor): "structuredClone()" should be used instead of other deep cloning methods
- [S7786](https://rules.sonarsource.com/typescript/RSPEC-7786/) (minor): Generic "Error" should be "TypeError" when thrown after type checking
- [S8927](https://rules.sonarsource.com/typescript/RSPEC-8927/) (minor): Default imports from modular utility libraries should not be used
- [S9382](https://rules.sonarsource.com/typescript/RSPEC-9382/) (minor): Promises should not be awaited sequentially in a loop
- [S1135](https://rules.sonarsource.com/typescript/RSPEC-1135/) (info): Track uses of "TODO" tags
